methods.label: Distinguish one solution from all solutions
methods.explanation: \(x=2\) does not satisfy \(x>2\), so it is not a solution. The inequality has infinitely many solutions. \(x=3\) is just one of its solutions. The collection of all solutions, \(x>2\), is the solution set.
